GratitudeNote.title: Gratitude Note
GratitudeNote.description: A family or guest gratitude message displayed on the shared Thanksgiving Gratitude Board.

name.description: Display name of the family member or guest who posted the note.

message.description: Short message describing what the author is thankful for.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp recorded when the gratitude note was created.

/gratitude_notes/{noteId}.description: Shared family Thanksgiving Gratitude Board entries readable across all guest devices.
